image_description: A close-up view of a bakery storefront window. The top shelf features a row of round, flour-dusted bread loaves (possibly sourdough or rustic rolls) sitting on wooden boards or trays. Below them, through the glass, the interior is visible with staff members wearing white uniforms and aprons working behind counters. There are display cases containing various pastries and baked goods. A small sign stands on the lower counter in the foreground. The lighting is warm and artificial, typical of an indoor retail environment.
